number_types.C: continuum energy enclosure in the stated ideal model; no interval arithmetic
number_types.P: uniform-grid or single trial tensor estimate; numerical check value

trace_and_spectrum.shared_trace: The curved outer Q1 element is Q1 in ray parameter t, not a straight chord. On the circle, t is affine in tan(theta) or cot(theta), exactly the coordinate used for the disk angular basis. Both field components share the same boundary DOFs; nodal equality therefore implies equality of the entire trace.
trace_and_spectrum.angular_weak_problem: integral Yprime^T s(theta) Zprime dtheta = lambda^2 integral Y^T s(theta) Z dtheta; periodic continuous traces; s Yprime continuous in the transmission sense
trace_and_spectrum.inner_product: (Y,Z)_s = integral Y^T s Z dtheta; s is the symmetric positive definite 2-by-2 field coefficient
trace_and_spectrum.spectrum: lambda^2 real nonnegative, complete mass-orthonormal eigenbasis; positive exponents need not be simple. Two constant field modes have lambda=0.
trace_and_spectrum.log_terms: Choose finite-energy (r/R)^lambda modes for lambda>0 and constants for lambda=0. Negative powers and the lambda=0 log(r) branch have infinite energy. Repeated positive self-adjoint eigenvalues are diagonalizable and do not force generalized log modes.
trace_and_spectrum.DtN: Ktheta Y = Mtheta Y diag(lambda^2), Y^T Mtheta Y=I; Bcircle = Mtheta Y diag(lambda) Y^T Mtheta. No continuum eigenmode truncation: all discrete angular modes are retained.

energy_interval_optimization.unknown: symmetric C of size 2d by 2d, d=2 or 3; L <= C <= U in Loewner order
energy_interval_optimization.symmetry: p4 in 2D or C4 about z in 3D gives sigma_xy_plane=a I. Three-dimensional bounds are C4 group averaged; the objective is invariant, so optimization over all matrices between these bounds admits a symmetric optimizer.
energy_interval_optimization.ordering: [electric x,electric y,(electric z),thermal x,thermal y,(thermal z)], zero-based indices
energy_interval_optimization.ratios: Sa=beta*c/a; Sxx=beta*b/a; beta=200e-6 V/K. sigma_plane=1e5*a S/m.
energy_interval_optimization.solver: numpy.linalg.eigh/eigvalsh for roots/support; scipy.optimize.brentq after geometric bracket expansion. 3D xtol=1e-13; the earlier 2D code uses the scipy default. No generic nonlinear optimizer or entrywise inversion of L,U.

RT0.interior_flux: J_d(t)=(1-t)Fminus_d+t Fplus_d, t in [0,1] along coordinate d
RT0.conformity: normal trace is single valued; divergence=sum_d(Fplus_d-Fminus_d)/h_d is constant in each cell and zero after periodic Hodge projection
RT0.projection: solve discrete Laplacian psi=div F; replace F_d by F_d-(psi_neighbor-psi_cell)/h_d; Fourier symbol uses h_d^-2
RT0.energy_per_direction: (Fm^T s^-1 Fm+Fp^T s^-1 Fp)/3+(Fm^T s^-1 Fp+Fp^T s^-1 Fm)/6
RT0.normalization: six flux trials form mean-flux matrix Q; B=Q^-T <J^T s^-1 J> Q^-1; L=B^-1. Volume average includes each physical cell volume. For equal rectangular voxels it is an arithmetic mean.
RT0.quadrature: The 1/3 and 1/6 weights are exact integrals of linear RT0 products. Spatial isotropy gives no cross-direction inverse-coefficient terms.

design_A64_winding_model_P.note: design_enclosures upper trial energy tensor is fixed input to device spiral calculations, not the exact continuum tensor

reference_data.Vcorr_path_prediction: Vcorr=Sa*integral(T_y dx-T_x dy), locally open circuit. For CCW positive n and radial outward heat flow: n*Sa*qprime/kappa.

bilinear_ring_geometry.meshing: Cartesian Q1 squares kept when cell-center radius is strictly between ri and ro; exposed square faces define staircase inner/outer boundaries. Boundary nodes have fixed T; no curved boundary elements or projection to exact circles.

device_spiral_geometry.meshing: same cell-center inclusion and exposed Cartesian faces; bilinear interpolation of nodal fields for terminal voltage and path gradients

annulus_formula_check.classification: P for bilinear tensor/numerical comparison; C only for the separately stated Fig1b continuum-tensor interval in the ideal homogeneous thin-sheet annulus
annulus_formula_check.convention: Sa=(Sxy-Syx)/2; right-handed x,y,z; inner-hot DeltaT>0; CCW current and +z magnetic field positive
annulus_formula_check.bilinear_convention: a_cross_z=-Sa; bilinear predicted() uses plus t*sigma*a_cross_z
annulus_formula_check.warning: bilinear uses the coarse 24-by-24 Q1 effective tensor. Its current and B are not the continuum predictions of the Fig1b tensor, despite identical material labels.
